steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize Doctor Diary project folder structures and metadata files.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Set up Gradle build settings using AGP 8.3.2 and Java 17 parameters.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Formulate AndroidManifest.xml specifying application properties, direct launch configurations, and correct namespaces.

steps.title: Define Resource Strings
steps.description: Create localization strings.xml file containing user-visible labels, headers, and tool categories.

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Implement DatabaseHelper.java to set up clinical tables for Patients, Appointments, and Prescriptions.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml featuring modern single-activity dashboard panel and dynamically toggled screens.

steps.title: Create Add Patient Dialog UI
steps.description: Design dialog_add_patient.xml containing formatted inputs for patient demographics and clinical histories.

steps.title: Create Add Appointment Dialog UI
steps.description: Design dialog_add_appointment.xml providing calendar scheduler inputs and purpose selection.

steps.title: Create Add Prescription Dialog UI
steps.description: Design dialog_add_prescription.xml containing symptoms, multi-line diagnosis, and dosage instructions fields.

steps.title: Develop Main Controller Logic
steps.description: Implement screen switching, databases updates, and menu selectors inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Patient Registry Engine
steps.description: Incorporate real-time Patient details listing, text search indexing, and records removal in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Build Scheduling & Appointment Trackers
steps.description: Incorporate calendar appointments tracking, completed toggles, and pending counters.

steps.title: Develop Prescription Generator & Share
steps.description: Program draft actions inside MainActivity.java supporting direct prescription compilation and Android Share Intent utilities.

steps.title: Implement Clinical Tools Calculations
steps.description: Program standard mathematical BMI formulas and liquid pediatric drug dosage calculators.

steps.title: Integrate SQLite States with UI Panels
steps.description: Create database callbacks to dynamically refresh metrics counter on dashboard transitions.

steps.title: Incorporate Material Design Elements
steps.description: Style UI using programmatically formatted card shapes, elegant custom paddings, and background coloring.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Check source parameters to guarantee absolute compliance with standard Java 8 parameters and classic callback definitions.

steps.title: Resource Optimization
steps.description: Teardown cursor arrays and optimize SQLite memory caches to achieve peak stability.

steps.title: Final Deployment Validation
steps.description: Verify namespace parameters and AndroidManifest attributes compile perfectly.

steps.title: Building Doctor Diary
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build final production package.
